CF3_OLD.pChiefComplaint: Productive cough of 3 weeks duration with hemoptysis, low-grade fever, night sweats, and unintentional weight loss of 5 kg
CF3_OLD.pBriefHistory: 52-year-old male, non-smoker, no known TB contact, presented with 3-week history of productive cough with blood-streaked sputum, intermittent low-grade fever (Tmax 38.2 C), drenching night sweats, and unintentional weight loss of 5 kg over the past month. No prior history of PTB or anti-TB therapy. Admitted for diagnostic workup and treatment initiation.
CF3_OLD.pCourseWard: Sputum AFB returned 3+ positive on Day 1. Started on standard 4-drug anti-TB regimen (HRZE) intensive phase. Tolerated medications well; afebrile by Day 3. Counselled on adherence, drug side-effects monitoring, and the 6-month treatment duration. Discharged stable on continued HRZE intensive phase with outpatient TB-DOTS follow-up at the nearest health center.
CF3_OLD.pPertinentFindings: Thin, ambulatory, mildly tachypneic. Lung: decreased breath sounds and fine crackles over left upper lobe. CXR PA: cavitary infiltrate L upper lobe consistent with reactivation PTB. Sputum AFB: 3+ positive on direct smear. Extremities: no edema, no compartment tenderness, distal pulses 2+ bilaterally.
